data.one_liner: Work with Gradle properties files easily in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Allows loading, reading, modifying, and saving Gradle properties files through a map-like interface and file extensions.
use_when: You need to read or update gradle.properties files programmatically in a Dart/Flutter project.
You want to manipulate key-value pairs in standard Java properties format files.
avoid_when: You are dealing with complex non-property file formats.
strengths: Provides a simple map-like interface for properties.
Supports saving changes back to the same or a different file.
weaknesses: Very niche use case limited to Gradle/Java properties files.
